nodes.label: Autopilot holds at KEA until fuel exhaustion

_facts: CLAIMS-helios522.md probable cause chain: (1) crew never recognized the selector in MANUAL; (2) never identified the true problem; (3) hypoxia; (4) fuel exhaustion; (5) impact. Contributing: engineer left selector on MANUAL after leak check; crew missed it on three checks (preflight, after-start, after-takeoff); identical horn tone caused the misdiagnosis; Boeing manual had no explicit AUTO-confirm step. Times: 01:25h landing, 03:15h release, 09:07 takeoff, 09:12:38 horn at 12,040 ft, 09:14:11 last transmission, 09:23:32 FL340, 11:49:50 / 11:59:47 flameouts, 12:03:32 impact.
